verdict.rationale: Pika documents in-product reframing (Smart Resize: "Reframe for any format with AI") and an Upscale tool that adds resolution to video, so channel formats and higher resolutions can plausibly be produced without leaving the product. The evidence never names specific aspect ratios or video output resolutions; the 4K mention covers Seedream still images only. Missing for 10: explicit support for 16:9/9:16/1:1 video output, a documented native 1080p+ video export resolution, export format/encoding details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
